fieldValues.title: A short daily review and a weekly session
fieldValues.decision_question: How often does the owner review the work, and for what?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The owner holds a short daily review of the work in flight and a weekly session to ratify, affirm and rank.
fieldValues.rationale: A daily review keeps work moving; the weekly session is where judgement is spent. Cadence is a rule; what each review decides is recorded elsewhere.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a review or session is skipped or runs long three cycles running, or proposed decisions wait unratified for more than a week.
